name: Control & Policy Networks
description: Selectable policy network architectures (SVNet, PAVE, SIFU, DNNet, ViT feature extractors) built on a shared base_net abstraction, plus the factory, tensor helpers, and Pilot/Policy runtime classes that turn observations into drone flight commands.

name: Flight Deployment
description: Real-world and FiGS-simulated flight execution: rollout deployment of trained pilots, MAVSDK-based drone/camera command dispatch, and flight-performance metric helpers.

name: Training & Instruction
description: Imitation-learning training loop for pilot policies, with mixture-of-experts loss functions and PyTorch dataset loaders over the synthesized flight data.

name: Data Synthesis
description: Generation and compression of synthetic visual-inertial training data by rolling expert trajectories through Gaussian-splat scenes, including domain randomization and observation assembly.

name: Shared Utilities & Visualization
description: Cross-cutting flight-dynamics and numerical helpers plus the matplotlib plotting, Rich console reporting, and flight-recording utilities that the control, flight, synthesize, and instruct layers all draw on.

name: Configuration
description: JSON configuration data that parameterizes the code: camera capture profiles, flight courses, data-generation and evaluation methods, neural-network I/O schemas, pilot definitions, and drone/scene frames.

name: Documentation & Examples
description: The project's GitHub Pages website (HTML, CSS, and vendored Bulma carousel/slider JavaScript) together with the Jupyter notebooks that demonstrate FiGS simulation and the SousVide training pipeline end to end.

name: Project Metadata & Environment
description: Repository-level README, Python packaging metadata, the Conda environment specification, the FiGS git submodule wiring, and tooling ignore rules that define how the research codebase is built and run.
